title: Transient capacity crediting and provisional reservation workflow
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an operational workflow and UX for issuing provisional reservations (short-lived capacity credits) to cover bursty customer demand while formal reservation approvals and capacity planning run their course. This ticket scopes the intake form changes, provisional allocation logic, reconciliation rules, billing adjustments, telemetry and audit trails, and abuse/overcommit protection required for a safe rollout. Goal: reduce failed requests during approval latency windows and provide predictable throughput guarantees for customers without permanently blocking capacity or creating manual overhead for SRE/billing teams.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can request a provisional reservation via the updated intake form and receive an immediate provisional allocation response
Provisioned credits appear in the console with clear expiry, throughput limits, and audit metadata
Autoscaling + provisional credits integrate with existing Dedicated fleet controls so provisional capacity can be consumed without violating SLOs for committed tenants
Reconciliation job runs daily to convert provisional allocations into committed reservations, expire unused credits, and create billing adjustments with audit logs
Telemetry shows provisional allocation rate, conversion rate to committed reservations, and any SLO violations attributable to provisional consumption
Security review sign-off and abuse mitigations (rate limiting, per-customer provisional caps) implemented
implementation_plan: Week 1: Finalize intake schema changes and UX copy with Design; prototype API for provisional allocation (internal + external endpoints)
Week 2: Implement provisional allocation engine in Dedicated control plane; add expiry timer and metadata tags for owner, request id, and justification
Week 3: Integrate provisional allocations into realtime scheduler and autoscaler with soft caps and fallbacks to lower-cost model variants
Week 4: Build reconciliation pipeline that reconciles provisional vs committed reservations and emits billing events; implement console list and detail views
Week 5: End-to-end QA + security review, rollout in Canary to <5% of new reservation requests, monitor metrics, and iterate
rollout_plan: Phase A (Canary): Enable provisional reservations for new signups and existing customers who opt in; telemetry collection enabled; alerting for spike in provisional usage
Phase B (Limited GA): Expose provisional option in intake form for customers with verified billing and a usage history threshold
Phase C (GA): Turn on for all self-serve customers with per-account caps and automated reconciliation enabled
Rollback: Disable provisional allocation switch; issue expiry for active provisional credits and notify affected customers
risks_and_mitigation: Revenue leakage from orphaned provisional credits: mitigate with daily reconciliation and automatic write-offs after N days
SLO violations if provisional consumption outcompetes committed tenants: enforce soft caps and priority-aware scheduler; surface oversubscription alerts to ops
Abuse (customers spinning up provisional credits repeatedly): require billing verification and per-account provisional rate limits; flag anomalous patterns for manual review
Operational complexity: keep provisional allocation engine simple initially (fixed-size credits, single expiry TTL) and iterate toward more dynamic heuristics
notes: Reference ticket for capacity-intake patterns: PM-63210
